keywords.def: looking back to check what we know

questions.q: Show me the steps of wudu in order, saying each one.
questions.a: Niyyah and Bismillah, hands, mouth, nose, face, arms, head and ears, feet

questions.q: Is a doubt enough to break wudu?
Wudu and adhan quiz on the pupil PDF (eight questions), then the wudu practical with the teacher's checklist.
questions.a: Quiz answers from the lesson; practical ticked step by step

questions.q: Extend: write the adhan lines in order.
questions.a: Allahu akbar; ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah; ash-hadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah; hayya 'ala s-salah; hayya 'ala l-falah; Allahu akbar; la ilaha illallah

questions.q: Stretch: explain fard and sunnah using two wudu steps.
questions.a: Face is fard (named in 5:6); rinsing the mouth is sunnah (the Prophet ﷺ did it).
A) Rinsing the mouth. Mouth and nose are sunnah; face and feet are named in 5:6.

questions.q: We wash the feet up to the ...
Think again: what will you practise so your wudu is careful every time?
questions.a: For example: washing the elbows fully, saving water, saying the du'a
